verdict.rationale: Qodo is an AI code review platform with agentic features, so consuming external MCP servers is a fair capability to ask about. However, the evidence documents only Qodo exposing its own skills as an MCP server for other agents (qodo-docs-33, qodo-probe-3). That is the server role and does not show users can plug third-party MCP servers into Qodo. No evidence shows MCP client support.
